question: Why did my taxes go up so much after I bought my house? Nobody told me this would happen.
notes: CITIZEN VOICE. Written deliberately in the register a resident uses at the counter, not statutory language. Added 2026-08-03 after discovering the existing suites were phrased semi-statutorily and therefore could not detect the citizen-phrasing retrieval defect at all — the one clerk case that caught it did so by accident. VERIFIED: retrieval MISSED MCL 211.27a entirely before query expansion. This is the single most common taxpayer complaint at an assessing counter.
